extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Generate strong, random passwords with your browser's secure random number generator. Everything stays on your device.
extDescription.description: Extension description. Keep it at 132 characters or fewer (Web Store limit).

commandOpen.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut that opens the popup.

menuInsertPassword.description: Context menu entry shown on editable fields.

generatedPasswordLabel.description: Accessible name of the section that shows the password.

regenerate.description: Button that generates a new password.

regenerateTitle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the Regenerate button.

historyButton.description: Button that opens the password history.

strengthMeterLabel.description: Accessible name of the strength meter.

optionsLabel.description: Accessible name of the options section.

lengthLabel.description: Label of the password length field.

lengthSliderLabel.description: Accessible name of the length slider.

charactersLegend.description: Heading of the character type checkboxes.

avoidLookalikes.description: Checkbox that removes easily confused characters such as 0 and O.

excludeCharsLabel.description: Label of the field listing characters to leave out.

excludeCharsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the exclude characters field.

clipboardClearLabel.description: Label of the clipboard auto-clear selector.

keepHistoryLabel.message: Keep a history of the last $COUNT$ passwords
keepHistoryLabel.description: Checkbox that enables the password history.

keepHistoryHint.message: Passwords are kept unencrypted in browser memory only and are erased when Chrome closes. Turning this off deletes the history.
keepHistoryHint.description: Privacy note shown below the history checkbox.

footer.message: Passwords are generated locally with the browser's CSPRNG. Nothing is sent anywhere. Right-click a text field to insert one.
footer.description: Footer note of the popup. CSPRNG means cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator.

historyViewLabel.description: Accessible name of the history section.

historyEmpty.description: Shown when the history is empty.

back.description: Button that leaves a screen (history, settings or about) and returns to the generator.

historyClear.description: Button that deletes the whole history.

historyCleared.description: Status shown after the history was deleted.

statusCopyFailed.message: Copy failed. Select the password and copy it manually.
statusCopyFailed.description: Status shown when copying to the clipboard failed.

statusCopiedNoPermission.message: Copied. Auto-clear needs clipboard permission; re-select the option to grant it.
statusCopiedNoPermission.description: Status shown when the clipboard auto-clear permission is missing.

statusCopiedClearIn.message: Copied. The clipboard will be cleared in $SECONDS$ s.
statusCopiedClearIn.description: Status shown after copying when the clipboard will be cleared automatically.

statusScheduleFailed.message: Copied, but scheduling the clipboard clear failed.
statusScheduleFailed.description: Status shown when the auto-clear timer could not be set.

statusClipboardPermissionRequired.message: Clipboard permission is required to clear it automatically.
statusClipboardPermissionRequired.description: Status shown when the user denied the clipboard permission.

statusSaveFailed.description: Status shown when the settings could not be stored.

errorGeneric.description: Fallback error shown in place of the password.

errorInvalidLength.description: Error shown in place of the password.

errorNoCharset.message: Select at least one character type.
errorNoCharset.description: Error shown in place of the password.

errorLengthTooShort.message: Length is shorter than the number of selected character types.
errorLengthTooShort.description: Error shown in place of the password.

settingsButtonTitle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the settings button in the popup header.

aboutButtonTitle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the button (GitHub icon) that opens the About screen.

languageAuto.description: Language choice that follows the browser's language.

themeLabel.description: Label of the color theme selector.

themeSystem.description: Theme choice that follows the operating system.

contextMenuLabel.description: Checkbox that shows or hides the context menu entry. $ITEM$ is the entry's own name.

maskPasswordsLabel.description: Checkbox that blurs passwords on screen until the pointer is over them.

settingsReset.description: Status shown after the settings were reset.

aboutVersion.description: Version of the extension on the About screen.

aboutAuthor.description: Credit line on the About screen. Keep the name unchanged.

aboutLicense.description: License line on the About screen.

aboutPrivacy.message: Everything runs on your device. Padlock collects no data and sends nothing anywhere.
aboutPrivacy.description: Privacy statement on the About screen.

aboutRepositoryLabel.description: Caption above the link to the GitHub repository.
